name: Horned Lizard

review.observation: Full original: broad squat spiny body, backward-pointing crown horns, pointed flank fringe and natural short tail. Crown horns and marginal spikes are exaggerated; species realism needs review. Only three independent feet can be confirmed; the far forelimb is unresolved behind the near foreleg. HOLD for unresolved fourth limb and exaggerated ornament. Broad margins.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
